questions.question: To what does Proverbs 26 compare a fool who repeats his folly?
options: An ox that strays from the herd
A lion that hunts in the night
A bird that flies from its nest
A dog that returns to its vomit
questions.answer: A dog that returns to its vomit

questions.question: What happens to fire without wood, according to Proverbs 26?
options: It spreads quickly, and so strife consumes the whole house
It goes out, and where there is no whisperer, quarreling ceases
It grows larger, and gossip only spreads it further and further
It is fed and tended, and the whisperer keeps it alive and burning
questions.answer: It goes out, and where there is no whisperer, quarreling ceases
